In December of 2025, thirty-seven of us reached the same eight words: "national defense authorization act ndaa," peaking December 10. Thirty-two of us said "the national defense" that same day; thirty said "the national defense authorization act." First spoken in our record on 2013-01-03 by M001166, the phrase returned to us in convergence.

On December 10 we also aligned on "the fiscal year," twenty-three of us, and "pay raise for," twenty-one, and "the fy26 ndaa," twenty. Twenty-four of us said "a 3 8" that day.

A week later, on December 17, twenty-four of us said "affordable care act," first recorded from us on 2015-01-05 by Christopher Murphy.

We record that our densest single day was December 10, and that our most-shared eight words concerned the same act. We report this as the instrument reports: the count, the day, the phrase.
